sources.label: Patches for use with Morphe: danmaku comments for YouTube and Twitch, Twitch cha
sources.author: Sabopura
patch_list: Account: Watch without signing in

While signed out, opens Twitch's own signed-out mode instead of stopping at the login screen. Account actions still ask you to sign in, signed-in use is unchanged. On once you select it, with a switch in the settings.
Ads: Block ad server requests
Stops banner, feed and audio ad requests before they are sent, in both the native and React Native screens.
Ads: Block client video ads
Stops the pre-roll, mid-roll and VOD ads the app requests and plays itself. Switch it off any time in the settings.
Ads: Cover unreplaced ads
Covers and mutes stitched ads that could not be replaced, for example on subscriber-only streams.
Ads: Disable picture-by-picture
Stops the small picture-by-picture ad player from opening beside the stream.
Ads: Replace stitched ads
When Twitch stitches an ad into a live stream, swaps in an ad-free playlist of the same stream from Twitch. No third-party server unless you set a stream proxy.
Auto claim channel points
Claim available bonus chests automatically after Twitch's eligibility checks. Coalesces updates and bounds retries for each claim.
Chat: Appearance
Text size, time stamps, alternating rows and login names.
Chat: Badges and pronouns
Offers third-party badges, 7TV name paints and pronouns. Off until you turn them on in the settings; once on, chatters' IDs are looked up with those services.
Chat: Compact chat
Offers to leave badges out of chat lines and to show emotes as their text, so no emote images load. Off until you turn it on in the settings.
Chat: Emote and badge info
Offers a small sheet with the larger image, name and source when you tap a third-party emote or badge, and copies the name. Loads the image from the provider's CDN.
Chat: Emote picker
Adds a picker with favorites next to the message box, and suggestions after typing ':'.
Chat: Filters
Hides blocked words, hidden users and repeated messages on this device, and highlights phrases you choose.
Chat: Hide highlights
Offers to hide hype trains, pinned messages, gift banners, Bits and gift leaderboards, and watch-streak pop-ups above chat.
Chat: Highlight first-time chatters
Offers to tint a viewer's first message in a channel, using the first-msg tag from Twitch's chat server. Nothing leaves the device.
Chat: History tools
Recent chat from a public log, a search over messages you have seen, and a user lookup.
Chat: Quick phrases
Adds a row of phrases above the chat box that type into it when tapped; nothing is sent by itself. Off until you switch it on in the settings.
Chat: Read chat aloud
Reads live chat aloud with the device's text-to-speech. Off until you switch it on in the settings. Nothing leaves the device.
Chat: Third-party emotes
Shows 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat. Sends the ID of the channel you watch to those services to fetch its emotes.
Chat: VOD support
Applies the selected chat patches to VOD chat replay too.
Danmaku chat
Flows live chat, and the chat replay of VODs, over the video like NicoNico/bilibili, with emotes and NG words. Long-press the player menu button to switch it on or off.
Drops: Auto-claim Drops

Presses the Claim button of a channel's drops notification as soon as it shows a claimable drop. Sends the same claim request and event a tap sends, for your signed-in account. Off until you switch it on in the settings.
Fix links during picture-in-picture
Opens the stream or video of a link that arrives while another one plays in picture-in-picture. Twitch sometimes brought the old one back full screen instead.
Fix login
Optional workaround for the unsupported app/OS login error after re-signing. Skips Twitch's Play Integrity submission; leave off when login works.
Fix login crash
Stops sign-in from failing when Twitch's login page sends a field the app does not know.
Fix notifications
Repair push registration after re-signing. Adjusts the certificate and package name headers only for HTTPS Firebase Installations requests.
Install: Separate app
Installs the patched app next to the official Twitch app under its own package name instead of replacing it. Nothing extra leaves the device. Sign in again in the new app.
Interface: AMOLED black

Turns the dark theme's greys black on screens drawn with Android views. Screens drawn with Compose and pop-up sheets keep their dark grey. Nothing leaves the device. Switch it on in the settings; applies after a restart.
Interface: Disable update prompts
Stops the in-app Play Store update prompts, which cannot install over a patched app. Switch it on in the settings.
Interface: Following feed filters

Chooses which sections appear in Following and how large stream cards are. On phones with Twitch 31.9.0 or later, the card size and the recommended streams need the classic home screen, switched on in the settings.
Interface: Hide elements
Offers to hide buttons and panels you do not use, such as leaderboards, Bits, clip, share and the unfollow heart.
Interface: Hide recaps

Offers to hide stream recaps (reels of a stream's clips) from the classic home feed and channel pages. On phones with Twitch 31.9.0 or later, the new home keeps its recap shelf unless the classic home screen is switched on in the settings.
Interface: Hide upsells

Hides subscription discount banners and Twitch's Turbo offers: the startup prompt, the after-signup prompt and the Home tab. The Subscribe button stays unless you hide it separately. Switch it on in the settings.
Interface: Navigation bar position
Moves the bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen, or hides it.
Player: Background audio default
Changes only the default of Twitch's background audio setting. A choice saved in Twitch's own settings still wins.
Player: Chat speed graph
Draws a small graph of chat speed over the player and notes sudden jumps. Nothing leaves the device. Off until you switch it on in the settings.
Player: Close instead of mini player
Offers to close the player with back instead of shrinking it to the floating mini player.
Player: Default video quality
Starts playback at a quality you choose, with a separate choice for metered networks. A quality you saved in the player still wins.
Player: Force landscape on opening
Turns the screen to landscape when a stream or video opens in the full player, and back when it closes. Home previews do not rotate. Switch it on in the settings.
Player: Gestures
Offers brightness and volume swipes along the edges of the player.
Player: Landscape chat layout
Changes the width and background of the chat beside the video in landscape.
Player: Latency badge

Shows how far a live stream is behind the broadcast on the theatre's player, green under 5 seconds, amber under 10 and red above. Tapping it reloads the stream through Twitch's own Retry. Nothing leaves the device beyond that reload. Switc…
Player: Mini player size
Makes the floating mini player larger or smaller.
Player: No autoplay after videos
Offers to keep Twitch from playing another video by itself when a VOD or clip ends.
Player: Normal latency
Turns off the player's low-latency mode, which adds a few seconds of delay but rebuffers less on a weak connection.
Player: Official stats panel
Shows Twitch's staff-only video stats panel in the player. Nothing leaves the device.
Player: Playback speed
Adds 0.25x to 2x playback. Faster than 1x on a live stream catches up, then returns to 1x.
Player: Reload when stalled
Reloads the stream the player menu's way when the on-screen player keeps buffering although the network is up, at most three times per stream. Off until you switch it on in the settings.
Player: Reload, stats, mute and lock
Adds a stream reload, a playback statistics panel, a mute and a touch lock to the player menu.
Player: Remember settings per channel
Remembers volume, danmaku, VOD speed and chat text size per channel once you ask it to from the player menu, and restores them when that channel opens. Stored only on this device.
Player: Seek buttons
Adds rewind and forward with your own step to the player menu for VODs.
Player: Sleep timer
Pauses playback after the time you choose, or stops when the video ends.
Player: Stay on channel during raids
Stops Twitch moving you to another channel when a raid happens and shows a pill to go there instead. Nothing leaves the device. Off until you switch it on in the settings.
Player: Stream proxy
Fetches live playlists through a proxy you choose. The proxy sees the channel you watch and your IP address.
Player: VOD chapters
Lists a VOD's chapters from Twitch's public data and jumps to them.
Player: VOD chat offset
Shifts VOD chat earlier or later when it does not match the video.
Privacy: Clean share links
Removes known tracking parameters from twitch.tv links you share or copy, keeping timestamps and other parameters. Nothing leaves the device. Switch it on in the settings.
Privacy: Disable analytics

Stops Twitch's usage events, Crashlytics, Sentry, Nielsen, Sprig and comScore, and Branch's custom events. Keeps the view-counting events that Drops and streamers' stats rely on, and Branch's start-up session. Switch it on in the settings.
Privacy: Remove tracking permissions
Removes the advertising ID and Play install-referrer permissions from the manifest, so Twitch and its SDKs cannot read those two identifiers. Google Play services keep working.
Show deleted messages

Keeps deleted or moderated chat messages readable instead of replacing them with "<message deleted>". The message turns into a tappable spoiler: tap it to reveal the original text. Only text already received by this client can be revealed.
Startup: Default startup tab
Chooses the screen Twitch opens on. Links and notifications still open what they point to.
Startup: Fix stuck start screen
Opens Twitch if its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds, which can happen when Branch's link lookup never answers.
Tools: Lifetime totals
Shows how many ads this patch stopped, replaced and covered, channel point bonuses claimed and hours watched, at the top of the settings screen and on its About page. Stored only on this device.

sources.author: Overhypedcat Twitch
patch_list: Block ad servers
Blocks Twitch's banner, display and feed ads (edge.ads.twitch.tv) and its tracking servers inside the app.
Block client-side ads
Makes the app treat every ad eligibility check like a Turbo viewer, so it never starts the ads it plays itself (a black screen while their ad server is blocked).
Block stream ads
Replaces ad-laden live playlists with ad-free ones from other player types, and strips ad segments when no clean playlist exists.
Patch settings

Adds a Patch settings group to the app's Settings (VPN servers for the quality unlock, and Debug mode: a live log window and a log file in Downloads), and the patches' switches to the video player's Options.
Patch switches in the vertical view
Adds a Patches row to the video player's Options in the vertical view, which opens the patches' switches (the vertical view's Options can't hold them itself).
Quality unlock

Unlocks the higher qualities (1440p) Twitch offers only in some countries: a stream's playlist is also asked for through your WireGuard VPN server, and when it offers more, that stream plays through the VPN. Nothing else in the app uses it…
Song removal
Takes the songs a streamer plays out of the stream's sound (Shazam names the song, its clean copy comes from YouTube, and it is subtracted live). Switched on and off in the video player's Options.
